scripts.depcruise: pnpm run depcruise:generate && pnpm run depcruise:serve
scripts.depcruise:generate: pnpm run depcruise:generate:full && pnpm run depcruise:generate:high-level && pnpm run depcruise:generate:violation-report
scripts.depcruise:generate:full: mkdir -p reports/depcruise && pnpm exec depcruise apps packages --config --output-type dot | dot -T svg | pnpm exec depcruise-wrap-stream-in-html > reports/depcruise/dependency-graph.html
scripts.depcruise:generate:high-level: mkdir -p reports/depcruise && pnpm exec depcruise apps packages --config --output-type archi | dot -T svg | pnpm exec depcruise-wrap-stream-in-html > reports/depcruise/dependency-graph-high-level.html
scripts.depcruise:generate:violation-report: mkdir -p reports/depcruise && pnpm exec depcruise apps packages --config --output-type err-html --output-to reports/depcruise/dependency-violation-report.html
scripts.dev:checks: pnpm run lint && pnpm run fmt:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run syncpack && pnpm run depcruise:validate && pnpm run knip && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:e2e
scripts.syncpack: pnpm run syncpack:fmt:check && pnpm run syncpack:lint
